candidate.answerReason: A bisector makes each smaller angle half the whole angle. A, B and C express this relationship; D reverses it incorrectly.

methods.label: Compare the bisector relationships
methods.explanation: An angle bisector divides an angle into two equal parts, so \(\angle AOC=\angle BOC=\frac{1}{2}\angle AOB\) and \(\angle AOB=2\angle BOC\). The statement \(\angle AOC=2\angle AOB\) is incorrect.
methods.levelReason: The method uses only the Grade 7 angle-bisector definition and whole-half relationships.
